content_zh:
如果此书侵犯了您的权益，请点击访问作者版权投诉快速通道    而林老头知道了林逸在修炼《轩辕驭龙诀》后，基本上采取的是默许的态度。
也不指导但是却也不干涉，任由林逸自由发展。
不过，林逸在修炼了《轩辕驭龙诀》之后，虽然觉得自己的体质有了明显的上升，但是在武功上却也看不出有太多的改变。
无论如何，他都不是林老头的对手。
林老头就像游戏副本里面的BOSS一样，自己强了他就强了，自己弱了他也弱了，这是让林逸十分郁闷的一件事情。
如果硬说林逸有了什么改变，那就是他觉得自己的六识比以前敏锐多了，听觉和视觉上，比以前灵敏了一些。
日复一日，年复一年，林逸在没有任何人的指导之下，基本上也将这《轩辕驭龙诀》的第一阶修炼了个大概。
转眼间到了五年之期，又是一个月圆之夜，林逸再次的进入了西星山脚下的那个山洞石门。
不过遗憾的是，这一次林逸并没有林逸对这个结果也没有什么意外，因为他也知道自己的第一阶天蚕期并没有突破，到了中期之后，就没有任何的进展了。
虽然林逸也将自己的遭遇告诉了林老头，但是林老头也只是微笑着摇了摇头，表示他爱莫能助。
马上就是第二个五年之期了，林逸的心里愈发的焦急起来。
这么多年了，自己仍然在第一阶的中期停滞不前，如果再这样下去，那自己仍然会无功而返。
现在，林逸也已经明白了自己所修炼的《轩辕驭龙诀》并不是一种武功，而是一种类似修真类的秘籍。
听起来有些惊世骇俗，但是林逸明白，自己的的确确修炼的就是这个。
再回想起第一个月圆之夜林老头的奇怪举动，林逸甚至怀疑这一切是不是林老头有预谋的！
故意设下的圈套，将自己踢下西星山，然后进入那个石门。
不然怎么好巧不巧的林老头偏偏要在月圆之夜来考校自己的功夫呢？
就算要考校，也没有必要跑到山顶上去吧？
就算跑到山顶上了，你也不能下死手吧？
就算下了死手了，也不能那么巧合的就将自己给踢到山洞门口吧？

好吧，就算巧合的将自己踢到了山洞门口，那林老头为什么非要等到自己从山洞里出来之后，才来找自己？
而林逸将自己的所见所闻告诉了林老头之后，林老头所变现出的那种淡漠表情好像早就知道了如此一样！
这一切的一切，都让林逸很是怀疑。
不过，当林逸每次将自己的怀疑问起林老头时，林老头都不作答。
后来林逸也懒得问了，管他是不是故意的，自己修炼自己的！
林逸从入定状态清醒过来之后，窗外的天边已经泛起了鱼肚白。
林逸无奈的摇了摇头，虽然每次收功之后，都觉得有些进展，整个人也清爽的很，但是却依然没有大的突破。
快速的跑到了洗手间冲了个凉洗漱了一下，将自己身上的汗渍洗净，林逸穿上了一中的校服，走出了房间。
整个别墅里还是静静的，林逸抬头看了看楼梯的方向，两个女孩子应该还在睡觉吧？
林逸左右无聊，坐在沙发上，将客厅中的七十寸的大液晶电视大电视就是爽啊，林逸悠哉的躺在了沙发上，这还是他第一看这么爽的电视呢！
以前在家里，除了一台山寨笔记本可以显示人影之外，就剩下一台二十五寸的大脑袋电视了。
“阿嚏！”
林逸打了个喷嚏，没想到自己的体质还能感冒。
不过想到自己一直生活在南方，而这里是北方，虽然是夏天，但是因为昼夜的温差相差比较大，所以出现水土不服也是正常的。
林逸随手从茶几的纸巾盒里抽出了两张纸巾来，擦了擦鼻涕，扔在了一旁。
不过这一大早的，大多数频道都没有节目，林逸按下了手中遥控器的换台按钮。
可是按了半天，电视也没反应，依然是个大地球无节目的画面。
“这遥控器不会是没电了吧？”
林逸暗骂了一句，不过转念一想，不对呀，自己刚刚不是用这遥控器想到这里，林逸又仔细的观察了一下电视附近。
原来别墅里安装的是卫星电视，需要机顶盒的遥控器才能进行换台，而电视的遥控器仅仅可以控制电源和音量。

虽然林逸来自农村的大山里，但是因为林老头给他买了一个山寨上网本，通过互联网，对外面的一些科技和知识都有了解，所以这时候表现的也不是太文盲。

content_en:
If this book infringes upon your rights, please click to visit the author's copyright complaint fast track. After Old Man Lin learned that Lin Yi was practicing "Xuanyuan Yulong Jue", he basically adopted a tacit attitude.
He didn't give any guidance, but he didn't interfere either, allowing Lin Yi to develop freely.
However, after Lin Yi practiced "Xuanyuan Controlling the Dragon", although he felt that his physical fitness had improved significantly, he could not see much change in his martial arts.
No matter what, he is no match for Old Man Lin.
Old Man Lin is like the BOSS in the game dungeon. He becomes stronger when he becomes stronger, and becomes weaker when he becomes weaker. This is something that makes Lin Yi very depressed.
If Lin Yi had any change, it would be that he felt that his six senses were much sharper than before, and his hearing and vision were more sensitive than before.
Day after day, year after year, Lin Yi basically mastered the first level of "Xuanyuan Controlling the Dragon" without anyone's guidance.
In the blink of an eye, five years later, it was another full moon night, and Lin Yi once again entered the stone door of the cave at the foot of Xixing Mountain.
But unfortunately, Lin Yi was not surprised this time. Lin Yi was not surprised by this result, because he also knew that he had not broken through the first level of the Celestial Silkworm stage, and after reaching the middle stage, there would be no progress.
Although Lin Yi also told Old Man Lin about his experience, Old Man Lin just smiled and shook his head, indicating that he could not help.
The second five-year period is coming soon, and Lin Yi is becoming more and more anxious.
After so many years, I am still stagnant in the middle stage of the first level. If I continue like this, I will still return without success.
Now, Lin Yi has understood that the "Xuanyuan Dragon Controlling Technique" he practiced is not a martial arts, but a secret book similar to cultivation.
It sounds a bit shocking, but Lin Yi understands that this is indeed what he practices.
Recalling Old Man Lin's strange behavior on the first full moon night, Lin Yi even wondered if all this was premeditated by Old Man Lin!
He deliberately set a trap to kick himself down Xixing Mountain and then entered the stone door.
Otherwise, why would Old Man Lin come to the school to test his kung fu on a full moon night?
Even if you want to take the school entrance examination, there is no need to go to the top of the mountain, right?
Even if you run to the top of the mountain, you can't kill me, right?
Even if he had a fatal blow, he couldn't just kick himself to the entrance of the cave by such a coincidence, right?
Well, even if he kicked himself to the entrance of the cave by coincidence, why did Old Man Lin have to wait until he came out of the cave to come to find him?
And after Lin Yi told Old Man Lin what he saw and heard, the indifferent expression on Old Man Lin's face seemed to have already known this!
All of this made Lin Yi very suspicious.
However, every time Lin Yi asked Old Man Lin about his suspicions, Old Man Lin did not answer.
Later, Lin Yi didn't bother to ask, no matter if he did it on purpose or not, he cultivated himself!
After Lin Yi woke up from his trance, the sky outside the window was already turning white.
Lin Yi shook his head helplessly. Although he felt some progress and felt refreshed every time after completing his exercises, there was still no big breakthrough.
He quickly ran to the bathroom, took a shower, and washed away the sweat stains on his body. Lin Yi put on the uniform of No. 1 Middle School and walked out of the room.
The whole villa was still quiet. Lin Yi raised his head and looked in the direction of the stairs. The two girls should still be sleeping, right?
Lin Yi was bored. He sat on the sofa and turned on the 70-inch large LCD TV in the living room. It was so cool. Lin Yi lay leisurely on the sofa. This was the first time he had watched such a cool TV!
In the past, at home, in addition to a copycat notebook that could display human figures,All that's left is a 25-inch big-head TV.
"Ah sneeze!"
Lin Yi sneezed, but he didn't expect that his constitution could still catch a cold.
However, I think that I have been living in the south, and here is the north. Although it is summer, because the temperature difference between day and night is relatively large, it is normal to be acclimatized.
Lin Yi casually took out two tissues from the tissue box on the coffee table, wiped his nose, and threw them aside.
However, this early in the morning, most channels had no programs, so Lin Yi pressed the channel change button on the remote control in his hand.
But after pressing it for a long time, the TV did not respond. It was still a picture of a big earth with no programs.
"Isn't this remote control out of battery?"
Lin Yi cursed secretly, but then he thought, no, he didn't think of this with the remote control just now. Lin Yi carefully observed the area around the TV again.
It turns out that the villa is equipped with a satellite TV, and the remote control of the set-top box is required to change channels, while the remote control of the TV can only control the power and volume.
Although Lin Yi comes from the mountains in the countryside, because Old Man Lin bought him a copycat netbook, and through the Internet, he has learned about some outside technologies and knowledge, so he is not too illiterate at this time.
